# <span id="aanchor348"></span> TESTit Integrated Configuration

The TESTit Integrated Configuration screen contains the options relating to FLOWCAL integrated with TESTit 3.

This functionality is only available with TESTit 3 Integrated. You must have **TESTit Admin** privileges to edit in this screen.

<div class="procedure">

To access the TESTit Integrated Configuration screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **TESTit Integration Configuration** within the **Application** group.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 387;height: 387;" />

</div>

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />TESTit Integrated Configuration Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the TESTit Integrated Configuration screen:

#### Objects from TESTit

- **Meters** - Configure how FLOWCAL manages meters from TESTit. Available options are:
  - **Ignore** - Ignore all "enable meter" requests from TESTit.
  - **Report Only** - Generate a system message (3005) indicating that an "enable meter" request has been received from TESTit.
  - **Enable Existing** - Enable the meter for TESTit if it exists in FLOWCAL. If the meter does not exist, generate a system message (3003) indicating that an "enable meter" request has been made for a non-existent meter.
  - **Create or Enable** - Automatically create, if necessary, and enable a new meter with a business status of "On". If successful, a system message (3004) is created, indicating that the meter was successfully enabled.
  - **Create Pending** - Automatically create, if necessary, and enable a new meter with a business status of "Pending New".
- **PDF Reports** - Configure whether PDF test reports are brought over from TESTit. You cannot select which reports will be brought over; if this option is enabled, all reports associated with a given meter will be brought over and available to view in the Volume Editor.

#### Test Point Data

- **Apply Calibration Adjustments** - Specify whether meter tests from TESTit bypass the Review Test Report process and are automatically applied or sent for approval.
- **Accept New Report Revisions** - Specify whether new TESTit test report revisions override previous revisions. This process rejects pending PPAs and recalculates the adjustment using the new test data.
- **Cal Adj Gross Trip Point Pct** - Define a limit for individual transmitter errors on imported test reports to help flag potential erroneous data entry on test reports. Transmitter errors that exceed this trip point will generate an exception.
- **Correction Time Limit (days)**\* - Enter a system default for the maximum number of days that can be adjusted per test.
- **Calibration Adjustment Rule**\* - This read-only option is set to "Half Way Back" by default. You can select a different adjustment rule through the Contractual Limits Editor in Master Data Validation
- **Min Calibration Adjustment Pct**\* - Set a minimum percentage by which volume/energy must change at the monthly level for a calibration adjustment to occur.
- **Min Calibration Adjustment Unit Diff**\* - Set a minimum unit difference by which volume/energy must change at the monthly level for a calibration adjustment to occur.

#### Test Report Review

- **Show Individual Transmitter Corrections** – When checked, sets the default display mode for the Preview button on the [Review Test Report screen](../../Integration/TESTit%20Integrated/TESTit%20Manager/Test%20Report/Review%20Test%20Report.md).

\* These options are used to define system-level settings. Individual meters can still be configured under the Contractual Limits section of Master Data Validation. Those meter-level settings take precedence over system-level settings.

</div>
